note: D5 an upcycle never changes a count: kit [solar_lance, sun_flare+corona, moss_filter, seed_bomb] plus the oil_tithe graft is fire 3 - and one of those three tags is carried by a VARIANT row, which carries its base's tags verbatim, so _tag_counts reads the kit row straight with a guarded get and deliberately never folds through Content.base_id. The forge keeps moss_filter (a sun card, upcycled to moss_filter+sieve) and scraps seed_bomb, so no fire tag leaves the kit and the count is still 3 on the very next read. The lance then lights the oil the drill bot is standing on: the ignite hook roots it, and a rooted machine cannot take the D3 avoid:["fire"] step off its own burning tile ({t: rooted}), so the fire tick finishes the 1 hp the lance left. Same seed, board, graft and actions as d5_resonance_off except the scrap index; make _tag_counts skip variant ids, or make the forge drop a fire tag, and this record loses its hook, its root and its death in plain mode
